name: Nathalie Gerard
reason: Health rule: on nathaliegerard.be her Quantum-Touch work is sold mainly on pain and conditions. The session page lists arthritis, tendinitis, scoliosis, sciatica, migraines, fractures and recovery after mastectomy or radiotherapy, and the training page promises to relieve pain and cut reliance on medicines. Her other services are massage, a nutrition-for-health programme and career coaching, so too little would remain once the rule is applied.
